/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git show b84223c:extension/service_worker.js | rtk sed -n '130,225p'; printf '\\n--- current line range ---\\n'; rtk nl -ba extension/service_worker.js | rtk sed -n '145,220p'; printf '\\n--- architecture refs ---\\n'; rtk rg -n -C 5 \"landing|authoritative|readiness|inconclusive|receiver|content script\" docs README.md src tests | sed -n '1,320p'"

rtk .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.integration.test_extension_bridge tests.integration.test_extension_refresh -v'

rtk which python3 || true

rtk python3 -m unittest tests.integration.test_extension_bridge tests.integration.test_extension_refresh -v'

rtk env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m jobbot sync-extension"
